title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
abstract: arXiv:2610.13632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erd\H{o}s Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model

translated_title: 人本化奥赛智能体：一种通过求解、评审、维基、验证实现奥赛问题求解的多会话工作流
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在长周期科学与奥赛任务上的能力正迅速提升。近期的系统已经产生了纳维-斯托克斯（Navier-Stokes）问题的 Lean 形式化解答，以及对埃尔德什（Erdős）猜想数据库中四个开放问题的自主求解。然而，这些系统均未同时公开其底层模型与完整的推理技术栈。更广泛地说，单一智能体会话在困难问题上仍然脆弱：早期错误可能不断传播，缺失的领域知识可能使进展停滞，而表面上的成功可能掩盖了对原始任务的误解或弱化。我们提出 HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent，人本化奥赛智能体），这是一个开放的、流程级框架，通过三个互补的反馈通道来协调多个智能体会话。首先，一个独立的评审者对每个候选解进行评估并提供可操作的反馈。其次，一个结构化的维基提供模型中可能缺失或不可靠的任务特定知识……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出 HOA，一个开放的流程级框架，通过独立评审、结构化维基与验证三个互补反馈通道协调多个智能体会话，以解决单一会话智能体在奥赛难题上易传播错误、缺乏知识且可能曲解任务的脆弱性问题。
en_tdlr: HOA is an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels—independent review, a structured wiki, and verification—to overcome the brittleness of single-session LLM agents on olympiad-level problems, such as error propagation, missing domain knowledge, and task misinterpretation.
